item.title: Talk to Me Jimmy's 11-length victory in the Withers earns Kentucky Derby points
item.description: Talk to Me Jimmy romped to an 11-length victory in the $200,000 Withers at Aqueduct.

item.title: Former Jets 1st-round pick Darron Lee charged with 1st-degree murder in Tennessee
item.description: Former New York Jets player Darron Lee has been arrested in Tennessee and charged with first-degree murder.

item.title: Bucks beat Pacers 105-99 for first 3-game winning streak of season
item.description: Kevin Porter Jr. had 23 points, eight assists and seven rebounds and the Milwaukee Bucks beat the Indiana Pacers 105-99 on Friday night for their first three-game winning streak of the season.

item.title: St. John's upsets No. 3 UConn behind Zuby Ejiofor's double-double, secures ninth straight win
item.description: Zuby Ejiofor had 21 points, 10 rebounds, seven assists, three blocks and two steals to help snap Connecticut's 18-game winning streak.

item.title: Scotty Pippen Jr. makes season debut for the Grizzlies after toe surgery
item.description: Guard Scotty Pippen Jr. made his season debut for the Memphis Grizzlies on Friday night after undergoing surgery on his left big toe in October.

item.title: Ejiofor leads No. 22 St. John's past No. 3 UConn 81-72 at MSG, ending Huskies' 18-game win streak
item.description: Zuby Ejiofor had 21 points, 10 rebounds and seven assists as No. 22 St. John's beat third-ranked UConn 81-72, snapping the Huskies' 18-game winning streak.

item.title: Celts rally from 22-point deficit to edge Heat, 98-96
item.description: Jaylen Brown had 29 points while Payton Pritchard scored 24 points to help the Boston Celtics make their biggest comeback of the season, rallying from a 22-point deficit to defeat the Miami Heat 98-96.

item.title: Pelicans erase 18-point second-half deficit in 119-115 win over Timberwolves
item.description: Saddiq Bay scored 30 points, including two free throws, as the New Orleans Pelicans overcame an 18-point deficit to beat the Minnesota Timberwolves 119-115.

item.title: Henderson makes season debut for Portland after hamstring injury
item.description: Scoot Henderson made his season debut for the Portland Trail Blazers on Friday night after recovering from a torn left hamstring.

item.title: Electric motorcycle riders in Kenya demand more flexible battery networks
item.description: Electric motorcycles, also known as electric mobility bikes or e-bikes, are gaining ground throughout Africa.
